items.title: 1. The table of contents: which one?
items.where: the heading "Inner Signal App to the Rescue!"
items.question:
Three fresh readers read only the contents, with 16 situations a reader comes with (a friend shaking and not responding, a week later the world still feels unreal, planning a ceremony), and said where they'd look first. On the contents as it is, the two readers guessed on 6 and 5 of the 16, and both would have stopped at beach morning glory and missed niacin when they wanted the trip to end. On A, a third reader guessed on 4, and its first pick was right for all 16 ([what each reader found](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h39-20261109/toc/RESULTS.md)).

A (my pick):
Inner Signal App to the Rescue!
When to Bring In Outside Help

    When Peer Support Isn't Enough
    Who to Contact, and When   [moved here from Get One Human Anchor]

Tripsitting Yourself or Others   [your part heading split in two; your greeting still opens it]

items.title: Syrian rue oil: your notes as a new entry under Mental Stabilizers
items.my_version:
#### Syrian Rue Oil Makes the Trip Gentle & Sweet

Syrian rue (*Peganum harmala*) can be mixed into warm/hot oil (like coconut oil), just enough to cover it, then squeezed out thru cheese cloth. Within some minutes of the seeds soaking in oil (if it's hot, or maybe an hour if it's warm), the oil contains the oil-soluble harmalas, not harmine, harmaline, or THH in quantities that could make it a potent MAOI. In my experience there's no MAOI effect in Syrian rue extracted with oil (it won't activate DMT, rather it reduces DMT's effects). These oil-soluble harmalas have no effect when eaten, but when absorbed thru mucous membranes or vaped, they chill out psychedelic trip intensity, making them more gentle and sweet. On their own, they have some mild psychedelic properties though (like I felt like half of my head was sort of transparent), and significant mood boosting properties.

I have a friend with schizophrenia who would use about 1-2mL of this oil rectally when he was in psychosis, which helped at least as much as niacin and DMSO, equally effective as Geodon, an antipsychotic his doctors prescribed which makes him feel like a zombie.

Another option is vaping the whole Syrian rue seeds, as it seems that these oil soluble harmalas are concentrated on the outside of the seeds. Once ground up, vaping the powder is more stimulating, less relaxing (but variable since all is mixed together). However, if vaping the whole seeds, I would not assume there's no MAOI effect (even though it still seems to reduce DMT effects) since depending maybe on temperature and time, you might also vaporize the harmine and harmaline.

items.title: Syrian rue oil: what to keep it away from
items.comment: no what they should be careful about is vaping the whole seeds, that could be more likely to have an MAOi effect, there's almost no MAOi in 1-2mL of the rue seed oil, although with any new substance people should be careful to see how it affects them with smaller amounts which i think i said somewhere .
items.my_version: How much harmine and harmaline end up in a home-made oil can vary, so don't use Syrian rue in any form alongside antidepressants, MDMA, other MAOIs, or anything else on the stop list under Suspected Serotonin Syndrome. And if someone's on a prescribed antipsychotic, don't swap it for this oil without checking with whoever prescribed it.

items.where: Humic Acid Brings Brain to Optimal Function, P1
items.my_version:
#### Authentic Calming Essential Oils (or a Lime Peel)

If you don't have the Metta NMT sniffer, just use AUTHENTIC natural calming essential oils to smell, like rose geranium, jasmine, lemon/lime oils. Most of these oils are fake on Amazon so buy only directly from trusted essential oil vendors. It should not smell like a perfume. Even just taking a lime and scratch & sniff the peel can be relaxing.

items.title: What Kind of Aftermath Is This?: the relaxing herbs named
items.where: What Kind of Aftermath Is This?, P8
items.my_version: Somatic hyperarousal: This is not rumination, but more like akathisia, bodily restlessness. Try gentle movements (that yin yoga again!), slower breathing, grounding, and medical care if the symptoms are severe, unusual or longer-lasting than expected. I'd still go for my trusty relaxing herbs first, like beach morning glory, Syrian rue oil or the Metta NMT sniffer, and natural antipsychotics like DMSO and niacin.
